caseName: Etere v. City of New York
caseNameFull: Emmanuel Etere v. City of New York, New York

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until April 11, 2011, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
